purpose: Close the native instantaneous environment HH/Gaussian/current/field branch with derived geometry, both original inverses and initializer caches; not an advancing normal solver
derived: native all-value and all-flux Laplacians and pseudoinverses
configured-temperature original-material scalar conductivity and screening cache
supplied: original centres, midpoints, membrane/cell measures, owner and normals
ECM concentrations, full fluxes and extra readouts, or explicit B08 2D environment weight
reference: Pure stdlib Decimal 100/160-digit independent finite differences, separable Gaussian kernel, geometry, Gauss-Jordan Dirichlet inverse and Neumann constant-mode complement inverse; both full rounded buffers retained

tolerances.native_host: Exact values, shapes and dtypes; signed zero is not a physical distinction
tolerances.geometry: 64*eps*abs(reference), coordinates 8 ULP, zero exact; integer maps exact
tolerances.operator_inverse: 3e-13 named operator units + 6e-12*abs(reference), normalized Penrose/gauge residual <=1e-10
tolerances.B23_prefix: Existing instantaneous 32*eps*(ions+membranes+16)*gross+1e-30; never propagated into environment field budgets
tolerances.nearest_admission: Second-minus-first distance >64*eps*max(second distance,delta,tiny); native ties explicitly outside this narrower Cells admission

source_details.HH: Helmholtz-Hodge uses lapENVinv (Dirichlet), not prepared Neumann lapENV_P_inv; first returned AA is stored as B_field/mu
source_details.boundary_orders: HH L,R,B,T; separate Phi_b R,L,T,B; literal corners retained
source_details.source_diff: Negative one-sided derivative edges, positive central interiors; gradient has positive one-sided edges
source_details.gaussian: sigma1, radius4, ECM constant0; noECM reflect
source_details.noECM: Duplicate map last-write assignment; vm/2 indexed by cell owner into membrane buffer; gradient(delta*Phi); Phi_b stored separately
source_details.ECM: Surface denominator mean repeats areas at each membrane map, not occupied sites; screened gradient; native configured-temperature cache held fixed

limitations: Supplied geometry is not Voronoi seeding
No barrier initialization beyond explicit supplied B08 weight
Nearest ties are refused with native raw-choice evidence
No pump/ion/gap/voltage chronology or whole normal solver
No physical projector, conservation, field energy or propagated-state accuracy claim
Finite guards are stricter than native and retain actual refused arrays
